title: 1D dynamic programming: house robber
summary: For each house, choose the better of skipping it or taking it plus the best from two houses back.
note: No two neighbouring houses can both be robbed.

panels.label: dp[i]: best from the first i houses

narration.text: dp[i] will be the most money from the first i houses. With no houses, that's {dp[0]}.
If we skip house {i}, the best is the same as without it: {skip}.
If we take it, its {nums[i - 1]} adds to the best from two houses back, {dp[i - 2]}, for {take}.
If we take the first house, we get {take}.
Keep the better choice: the best from the first {i} houses is {dp[i]}.
The most money without robbing two neighbours is {dp[n]}.
